overview: Croatia is a country in south-eastern Europe, on the Adriatic Sea. Its capital and largest city is Zagreb. Croatia was part of Yugoslavia until it declared independence in 1991. It joined the European Union in 2013 and adopted the euro in 2023. Its coastline, islands and old towns such as Dubrovnik and Split make it one of Europe's most popular holiday destinations.

geography.text: Croatia has an unusual crescent shape. The north and east are part of the flat Pannonian Plain, crossed by the Drava and Sava rivers. The long Adriatic coast is lined with more than a thousand islands, with the Dinaric Alps rising just behind it. The Plitvice Lakes, a chain of lakes linked by waterfalls, are among its best-known natural sights.
